LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_ImperialGuardArmor.label: [Raven] Imperial Guard Armor
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_ImperialGuardArmor.descrip: The exclusive uniform of the Raven Fusang organization's elite frontline force, the Imperial Guard. It is equipped with a unique module that reflects melee attacks, with the reflection chance increasing based on the viscosity of Raven fluid covering the attacker.
